verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test environment, such as a test mode or test API keys, that separates testing from production data. Isolated cloud browser sessions (notte-docs-24) are execution isolation for browser instances. They still act on live websites, so they do not count as a non-production testing environment. The no-card free tier is a pricing trial, not a sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
